latestAnswer().details: Checks and validates prices from the underlying feed, returning zero only if the price is valid.

returns.maxUnderlyingPrice_: The validated max underlying price, always positive, returned as uint256 always 18 decimals
returns.maxWrappedRate_: The max rate of the wrapped asset to the underlying asset, always 18 decimals
returns.minUnderlyingPrice_: The validated min underlying price, always positive, returned as uint256 always 18 decimals
returns.minWrappedRate_: The min rate of the wrapped asset to the underlying asset, always 18 decimals
